purpose: Throughput comparison before the P0/P1/P2 formal runs. The four run directories were removed after summarising; this file is the evidence.

results.error: CUDA out of memory: tried to allocate 874.00 MiB; process held 10.28 GiB of a 10.75 GiB card

conclusions: Length bucketing cuts padding_fraction from 0.585 (sequential sampling, measured 2026-11-10) to 0.0026-0.0044.
Single card batch 16: old sequential sampler took 2h57m/epoch; with bucketing it is 1.06h/epoch (2.8x).
Dual card DataParallel scales only 1.08x over one card at batch 16; per-step overhead dominates for this 36M-parameter model.
Single card cannot hold batch 32 on an 11 GiB card; batch 32 requires data_parallel.
Best measured configuration is data_parallel batch 32 at 0.909h/epoch, only 15 percent faster than single card batch 16.
